title: Review bounded out-of-plan edits and search presentation assertions

rubric.text: Requires in-scope/mechanical support, no sibling region ownership, independent coverage and recorded decision; missing evidence blocks acceptance and retrospective review never authorizes silent expansion.
Owner brief searches all test suites, including browser/accessibility assertions, for shared labels/copy/action names; edits follow scope/ownership gates rather than blindly changing every match.

Public contract or migration-order changes receive explicit controller classification, retaining existing stakeholder/replan boundaries rather than an automatic fix or unconditional human approval for mechanical work.
